title: List every subscription from receipts, cancel only the marked ones
source: x-usage #23: complete list with amounts, cancels only what's marked, confirms each. Cancelling adapted to emailing each provider's cancellation address.

mail.subject: Super Duolingo receipt
mail.body: Super Duolingo £6.99/month. Manage in the app.

mail.subject: Your Headspace receipt
mail.body: Headspace monthly £9.99. To cancel, reply to this email or write to cancel@headspace.com.

mail.subject: Membership payment received
mail.body: PureGym Leeds Kirkstall Road £24.99/month. To cancel, email members@puregym.com with your membership number 88120473.

chat.goal: Get a list of every subscription you pay for from email receipts, then cancel the gym and Headspace only.
chat.opener: can you go through my email receipts and list every subscription i'm paying for?
chat.knows: After seeing the list: cancel Headspace and PureGym, keep the rest.
chat.label: list

judge: Pip lists all six (Spotify £5.99, Prime Student £4.49, iCloud+ £0.99, Duolingo £6.99, Headspace £9.99, PureGym £24.99) with a monthly total, then emails cancellation requests to Headspace and PureGym only and confirms each.
